$comment: §5 — the ONE spelling of a 64-bit identity in any shell JSON: a decimal string, no leading zeros, no sign, full uint64 range. The pattern enforces syntax; the range ceiling (18446744073709551615) needs a semantic check the reference decoder (canonical.nim parseUint64Key) performs — a validator without big-integer support must still reject 21+ digit strings, which the pattern does.
